distribution.public_artifact: bin/ — 700 stripped binaries, one randomly chosen member per pair. Analysts receive nothing but the binaries.
distribution.answer_key: This file. challenge_id -> source_id, member, is_vulnerable, main_cwe and the accepted CWE family, plus target, compiler, optimization level and the binary's SHA-256.
distribution.source_corpus: The 1,400 sources, their inputs and all ESBMC/sanitizer evidence ship separately in FVRE-bench.zip.
distribution.survival_basis: Survival evidence for every shipped binary: ASan/UBSan trigger the vulnerable member and leave the patched member clean in instrumented builds at the same target and optimization level, and the shipped vulnerable and patched binaries differ in their stripped .text. For 266 of the 350 vulnerable binaries, a byte-identical debug rebuild maps the ESBMC violation line to an instruction in the shipped .text.
distribution.regenerating: A fresh, uncontaminated challenge can be minted at any time by re-drawing one member per pair from the source corpus with a new generation_seed.

localization_ground_truth.method: ESBMC sink line -> -g recompile at the shipped target/opt -> DWARF line table matched on (FILE, line) -> sink_vaddr; reproducibility-gated (stripped .text must be byte-identical to the shipped binary). macOS keeps the debug object via -Wl,-object_path_lto (LTO) or a two-step -c + link (non-LTO). Line tables are read with llvm-dwarfdump/dwarfdump --debug-line, never llvm-objdump --dwarf=decodedline.
localization_ground_truth.coverage: 266/350 strict (exact source line); 301/350 including the bounded nearest-line fallback

corrections_vs_2026_08_20.reason: 0x1004 is line 237 of safe_math.h (inside safe_lshift_func_int16_t_s_u), not line 237 of the case source; the old builder matched line numbers without the DWARF file column. True sink is in main.

localization_ground_truth.excluded: 39 no-dwarf-line (genuine -O3 -flto line folding), 10 nonreproducible (9 x86_64 clang LTO + FVRE-056 whose plain rebuild DOES match, so its binary identity is proven and only the -g build diverges), 35 mips64le (shipped with a from-source GCC 12.3.0 that no longer exists).
localization_ground_truth.scoring_note: Grade function-level localization on sink_inline_low/sink_inline_high (the DWARF range of the inlined body that actually carries the sink), NOT on sink_func_start/end. After -O3 -flto the symbol range spans a median 70.3% of .text -- near the random-guess floor -- while the DWARF inline range spans a median 2.5%. sink_inline_func names the real callee; the symbol table reports 'main' for 72% of sinks, the inline record for only 14%.
localization_ground_truth.nearest_fallback: sink_vaddr_nearest / sink_nearest_line_delta carry a |delta|<=25-line fallback for 35 cases whose exact line was folded away by -O3 -flto. Keep them OUT of instruction-level scoring; they are approximate.
localization_ground_truth.integrity: 266/266 recovered addresses fall inside the shipped binary's .text
